hero.title: The wave arrives at your door
hero.subtitle: We bring a full-scale standing wave to your villa, set it up in the morning and take it away at dusk. You ride. We handle everything else
hero.posterAlt: A rider carving across a standing wave at a private villa

howItWorks.title: Three steps, one day, nothing for you to carry
howItWorks.description: From the moment the truck arrives to the moment it leaves, the day is run by our crew.

delivery.title: Delivery & install
delivery.body: Our crew arrives at first light, levels the rig beside your pool and runs the full safety check. Setup takes about ninety minutes and needs a flat 12 × 6 metre space with vehicle access.

session.title: Dial in your session
session.body: Water speed and wave shape are tuned to the rider in front of us — gentle for a first-timer, sharper for anyone who already surfs. Adjustments take seconds, not minutes.

ride.title: Ride all day
ride.body: The wave runs continuously until dusk. Two certified lifeguards stay on deck for the whole session, so the only thing your guests need to think about is whose turn it is.

safety.title: Engineered to be boring in the ways that matter
safety.description: Every unit is inspected before it leaves our yard and again once it is standing at your villa.
safety.imageAlt: The flowrider unit installed beside a private villa pool

gallery.title: Recent days out
gallery.description: A few of the villas we have set up at this season.

testimonials.title: Quietly, the best day of the summer

one.quote: The crew arrived before we were awake and the wave was running by breakfast. My daughter refused to get off it.
one.name: Noora A.

two.quote: I expected an inflatable toy. What turned up was a proper wave — my brother surfs and he could not fault it.
two.name: Khalid M.

three.quote: Twenty-two guests, nobody waiting more than a few minutes, and the garden looked untouched by the time they left.
three.name: Sara H.

space.question: How much space do I need?
space.answer: A flat, level area of roughly 12 × 6 metres with clear vehicle access for delivery. Grass, tile and poolside decking all work. If you are unsure, send us a photo and we will tell you honestly whether it fits.

water.question: Do you use my pool water?
water.answer: No. The unit is self-contained and arrives filled. Nothing is drawn from your pool and nothing is drained into it.

experience.question: Do my guests need to be able to surf?
experience.answer: Not at all. Most people who ride with us have never surfed. The lifeguards spend the first few minutes with each new rider, and the wave is softened for beginners at the turn of a dial.

weather.question: What happens if the weather turns?
weather.answer: Light wind and rain are fine. If conditions become genuinely unsafe we will move your booking to another date at no cost, and we make that call rather than leaving it to you.

booking.question: How far ahead should I book?
booking.answer: We run a small number of installations per week, so most weekends are taken two to three weeks out. Weekdays are usually available at shorter notice.
